# Original site snapshot

Frozen copy of the published Framer site from [joininyo.com](https://www.joininyo.com/), captured before local edits.

**Do not edit this folder.** Use it as the baseline when comparing against `editable/` (or a modified `exact/`).

```bash
# from repo root
npx --yes serve original -l 5175 --no-clipboard
```

Open http://localhost:5175
